title: The proposal sources format, version 1
description: Every source that a run used to write a proposal, with the reason for each: the file sources.json of each version of the artifact type proposal, beside proposal.md, for the agent of the next stage. A source is anything the run read, such as a web page, a ticket, a record in another system, a document or a file in a repository. The file is at most 1 MiB (1,048,576 bytes), which a JSON Schema cannot check. No object has a member this schema does not define.

sources.description: The sources the run used: empty when it used none.

kind.description: What kind of source it is, such as file, page, ticket, record or document: a lower-case letter, then up to 31 lower-case letters, digits and hyphens. The list of kinds is open; each factory uses the kinds of its work.

ref.description: Where the source is, in the form its kind needs, such as a path, a URL or an id: 1 to 2048 characters on one line. The schema does not check the form for each kind.

system.description: The host name of the system the source is in, such as crm.example.com or a repository host: labels of letters, digits and hyphens joined by dots, at most 253 characters. Absent when ref is enough to find the source.

container.description: The place inside the system that ref is relative to, such as a mailbox, a table or the folder of a further repository: 1 to 200 characters on one line.

locator.description: The part of the source the run used, such as lines 40-48, a section title or a field name: 1 to 500 characters on one line.

why.description: Why the source matters for the proposal, plain text on one line, 1 to 500 characters.

line.description: Text on one line. It has no control character: none of U+0000 to U+001F, U+007F and U+0080 to U+009F, so no tab, line feed or carriage return. It has none of the bidirectional controls, the marks U+061C, U+200E and U+200F, the embeddings and overrides U+202A to U+202E and the isolates U+2066 to U+2069; the separators U+2028 and U+2029; and the format characters U+00AD, U+180E, U+200B, U+2060 to U+2064, U+FEFF and U+FFF9 to U+FFFB.
